findings.title: Frozen plan aliases caller data and permits provider change after Groq start-prohibition initialization
findings.condition: Programmatic Python API: mutate the original shared plan dict after constructor; this is not a claim that changing the CLI plan file after loading mutates process memory.
findings.fix: Seal canonical JSON bytes internally, expose copies, compare admission identity to the immutable saved plan and preserve provider prohibition. Regression must assert Groq auth/spawn0 on caller-plan mutation or immutable identity stays original.

findings.title: Pinned artifact changed during credential callback executes without another hash check
findings.fix: Recheck frozen artifact identity after credential callback and immediately before Popen; retain reservation and stop/incomplete if changed. This closes the demonstrated cooperative callback window, not atomic check-exec against a hostile filesystem writer.

findings.title: Leader wait treats SIGINT exit as group termination while descendant remains running
findings.fix: Monitor the same start_new_session process group through grace, SIGKILL remaining members, and handle descendants after normal leader exit as incomplete cleanup. Do not start later work until containment; preserve unknown usage and no-refund reserve. Limit signals to the owned group.
